scope: Recover53 typed global-array expressions in20 original source functions across17 units: player_bits[2] element4 bytes and stack_data[32] element4 bytes with signed16-bit internal_card_id at offset0. Original selectors, masks and all other source bytes are retained. Native and rebuilt global layouts/absolute bindings match; nineteen active bodies have native affine address read/write multisets equal to the before artifact after removing the erroneous8/128 factors, and rebuilt code uses native4-byte scales/biases. Eighteen exact address read/write multisets match; Worms of the Earth has one bounded flag-effect proof showing identical OR8/AND-not8 effects and mutually unreachable duplicated OR stores, without repeated effect sites on a direct CFG path. Opaque loaded selector roots and piecewise CFG selectors are not asserted equal to source parameters or to each other; the proof covers relative address scales, fixed biases, widths and read/write counts, not complete value/alias/gameplay equivalence. The twentieth source function is inline-only in the native Nimble Obstructionist body and currently unused as a source definition; its exact original inline origins/ranges and source-repair recipe are retained. Old helper/caller receipts remain immutable through exact supersession guards.
